newsitem.title: USA: Resource Mortgage sees Q1 results similar to Q4.
newsitem.headline: Resource Mortgage sees Q1 results similar to Q4.

text.p: Resource Mortgage Capital Inc said it expects first quarter results to be comparable to its 1996 fourth quarter results.
The company earned $3.4 million in 1996's fourth quarter. Earnings per share were $0.70 on a primary basis and $0.69 on a diluted basis.

"Overall, we expect first quarter results to be comparable to our 1996 fourth quarter results. The economy continues to remain healthy, which should benefit both our multi-family and manufactured housting lending operations, which are targeted at new construction," company president Thomas Potts said.

"Plans for broadening our multi-family lending base into other commercial real estate lending have been implemented, and we expect fundings in the second quarter of this year. We continue to feel positive about the company's outlook for the year," Potts said.
